correctness.rationale: The frozen mathematics and the repaired reconfiguration theorem both check. Twin clique vertices give the compulsory occupancy bound. For the projection lemma, start the base chronology with all active roots and retain only original-root forces whose targets are outside that set; these remain legal, since the retained target is white and the base has no additional white neighbors. The reverse chronology lifts by filling the last white private vertex from a black clique vertex before an external root force. Equality gives the local choices. Within a fiber each jump stays within a block; across fibers it trades one active root for an inactive one. At each changing block there are 2r nested local pairs, so the product with the unchanged blocks gives the exact crossing multiplicity. The regular-fiber degree and connectedness then yield the edge and component formulas. This argument includes r=2 and retains the fixed-n and classical forcing hypotheses.
residual_risks: The replay is limited to the two checked small cases; proof, not enumeration, supports the parameter range.
